name: TinyRustLM
summary: Simplifies startup around a verified cached composition or a small MiniModel.org server seed, with technical acquisition controls in Advanced.

changes.summary: Restores an admitted cached composition first; otherwise automatically starts the smallest eligible MiniModel.org server-seeded composition, with visible progress and cancellation. Hugging Face, files, conversion and manual peer settings remain in Advanced.
Added strict six-member catalog admission, bounded direct-peer streaming, browser OPFS persistence, restart verification, cancellation, and atomic activation.
Routes a qualified local-conversion result through the authenticated companion into the same verified browser cache and activation path.

Keeps inference and prompts local, allows MiniModel.org to supply the initial verified seed, and distinguishes signed listings from current peer reachability. An unavailable or unqualified model is shown honestly.
